summary: Nine NBA Cup group games were played on Friday, and road teams won four of them. James Harden scored a night-high 51 points in Cleveland's 128-119 win over Indiana, while Franz Wagner's jumper with two seconds left gave Orlando a 113-111 win in Brooklyn. Scottie Barnes put Toronto ahead for good with 14 seconds left in a 105-102 win at Detroit, and Atlanta's 111-97 win over Charlotte was the night's largest margin.

games.headline: Hawks rally from 14 down to beat Hornets
games.story: Charlotte led 50-36 midway through the second quarter before Atlanta scored 12 straight points, and the Hornets took only a 57-56 lead into halftime. The Hawks went ahead for good at 68-65 in the third quarter, outscored Charlotte 31-19 in the period and led by as many as 19 in the fourth. Jalen Johnson scored 26 on 10-of-15 shooting with four steals, Aaron Wiggins added 19 and Dyson Daniels had 11 points, 10 assists and eight rebounds. Moussa Diabaté had 21 points and 15 rebounds for Charlotte, which was without Kon Knueppel.

games.headline: Franz Wagner jumper at the end sinks Nets
games.story: The game had 20 lead changes, and a 14-0 Orlando run spanning the first and second quarters built the game's biggest lead at 40-25. Julius Randle's free throws put Brooklyn up 111-109 with 1:24 left, Wendell Carter Jr. tied it with a putback with 30 seconds to go, and Franz Wagner hit a step-back jumper with two seconds left. Wagner finished with 35 points and seven assists, and Desmond Bane scored 21 with seven 3-pointers and five steals. Randle had 27 points and nine rebounds and Danny Wolf scored 20 for the Nets, while Orlando was without Paolo Banchero.

games.headline: James Harden scores 51 as Cavaliers beat Pacers
games.story: Indiana led 50-36 in the second quarter, but Cleveland went ahead for good at 60-59 late in the half. The Cavaliers outscored the Pacers 43-22 in the third quarter and led by 24 early in the fourth before Indiana won the final period 36-23. James Harden scored 51 on 15-of-26 shooting with seven 3-pointers and 14-of-14 free throws, and Donovan Mitchell added 20. Ivica Zubac had 21 points and 10 rebounds and Pascal Siakam scored 21 for Indiana; Cleveland was without Evan Mobley and Indiana without Tyrese Haliburton.

games.headline: Barnes layup with 14 seconds left lifts Raptors
games.story: Toronto led 69-55 in the third quarter, but Detroit answered with 11 straight points to get within 72-70. Cade Cunningham's 3-pointer put the Pistons ahead 102-101 with 19 seconds left, and Scottie Barnes answered with a driving layup five seconds later before Immanuel Quickley made two free throws. Barnes scored 29 on 14-of-21 shooting, Allen Graves had 20 points and 10 rebounds and Quickley added 18 points and 10 assists. Cunningham finished with 23 points and nine assists and Kevin Huerter scored 20 for Detroit, which was without Jalen Duren.

games.headline: Anthony Davis scores 36 as Wizards rally past Bulls
games.story: Chicago led by 15 in the second quarter and was up 60-46 late in the half. Washington scored the last six points before halftime and the first nine of the third quarter, then held the Bulls to nine points in the period to lead 75-69. The Wizards went ahead for good at 80-78 early in the fourth during a 12-0 run. Anthony Davis had 36 points and 11 rebounds on 16-of-26 shooting and AJ Dybantsa added 20 points and 10 rebounds, while Norman Powell led Chicago with 16.

games.headline: Thunder rally from 16 down as Gilgeous-Alexander scores 40
games.story: Oklahoma City scored the first 11 points, but New Orleans answered with 12 straight, took the lead in the first quarter and kept it until a 102-102 tie early in the fourth. The Pelicans led 94-78 late in the third quarter before a 9-0 Thunder run, and an 11-0 run in the fourth put Oklahoma City ahead for good at 104-102 with 8:52 left. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40 with eight assists, and Aday Mara had 22 points and 16 rebounds on 11-of-15 shooting. Zion Williamson and Jeremiah Fears scored 22 each for the Pelicans, and Oklahoma City was without Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren and Alex Caruso.

games.headline: Suns lead most of the way and hold off Jazz
games.story: Phoenix went ahead for good at 19-16 in the first quarter and led 61-49 at halftime after building a 16-point lead. Utah scored nine straight points to get within 105-101 with 40 seconds left, but Devin Booker answered with a layup and the Suns scored the last six. Booker led Phoenix with 23 points, and Miles Bridges and Dillon Brooks scored 18 each. Darryn Peterson had 20 points, 10 rebounds and eight assists and Jaxson Hayes had 18 points and 14 rebounds for Utah, which was without Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr.

games.headline: Late 10-0 run lifts Nuggets past Rockets
games.story: The game had 17 ties and 32 lead changes, and Houston scored 42 points in the third quarter to lead 102-99 after three. The Rockets led 115-110 late in the fourth before Denver scored 10 straight points, going ahead for good at 116-115 with 3:51 left. Nikola Jokić had 26 points and 11 assists, and Christian Braun and Cameron Johnson scored 19 each. Alperen Sengun had a triple-double for Houston with 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists, and Fred VanVleet added 25.

games.headline: Grimes 3-pointer late sends Lakers past Kings
games.story: Sacramento led 62-54 at halftime and by 11 early in the third quarter, and the teams were tied 15 times. De'Andre Hunter's floater tied it 103-103 with 1:56 left before Quentin Grimes hit a 3-pointer with 57 seconds to go for the final Lakers points. Luka Dončić led the Lakers with 25 points and eight assists, and Walker Kessler had 15 points and three blocks. Hunter scored 30 on 12-of-16 shooting with five 3-pointers and Domantas Sabonis had 19 points and 16 rebounds for the Kings, while the Lakers were without Austin Reaves.
